name: HBV Menu
description: A mod menu with noclip, speedhack, icon hack, a startpos switcher, hitboxes and more.

noclip.name: Noclip
noclip.description: Survive hazards and walls. The anti-cheat spike still kills you.

speedhack.name: Speedhack
speedhack.description: Enable the game speed multiplier below.

startpos-switcher.name: Startpos Switcher
startpos-switcher.description: Show on-screen arrows to switch between start positions in a level.

labels.name: Info Label
labels.description: Show FPS, noclip accuracy and a cheat indicator in the corner.

safe-mode.name: Safe Mode
safe-mode.description: If noclip or speedhack is on, completing a level will not be saved or submitted.
